title: AgentHeadError
description: Error body the agent-head read route emits from its own handler (400 validation, 404 agent not in the path project, 500). Fixed server-controlled text only; nothing client-supplied is echoed. The guards in front of the handler (authentication, project scope, permission) answer with the same closed vocabulary as agent_readiness/agent_readiness_error_schema.json (401, 403, and the closed 404 for a project outside the caller's reach), so its values are included here.

enum: agent id must be a non-empty string
environment must be a non-empty string
environment must be one of: default, development, production, staging, test
